  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

## TAKE A STAND. MAKE AN IMPACT.

Your voice is essential in shaping the future of emergency medicine.

Learn how to engage in advocacy and directly connect with your legislators to protect our field.

[ Stand Up. Speak Out. ][50]

### Is Your Residency Program on the List?

Each year, residency programs across the country earn recognition by enrolling every resident in
AAEM/RSA. These programs demonstrate a commitment to preparing future emergency physicians through
advocacy, education, mentorship, and leadership development. See this year’s 100% Residency
Programs—and learn how yours can become one of them.

[ LEARN MORE ][51]

### Earn CME on Your Schedule

Stay current with high-quality emergency medicine education whenever and wherever it works for you.
AAEM CME Online gives members complimentary access to a growing library of on-demand courses
developed by emergency physicians for emergency physicians. Whether you’re looking to sharpen your
clinical skills or fulfill CME requirements, learning is always just a click away.

[ LEARN MORE ][52]

## TAKE A STAND. MAKE AN IMPACT.

Your voice is essential in shaping the future of emergency medicine.

Learn how to engage in advocacy and directly connect with your legislators to protect our field.

[ Stand Up. Speak Out. ][50]

### Is Your Residency Program on the List?

Each year, residency programs across the country earn recognition by enrolling every resident in
AAEM/RSA. These programs demonstrate a commitment to preparing future emergency physicians through
advocacy, education, mentorship, and leadership development. See this year’s 100% Residency
Programs—and learn how yours can become one of them.

[ LEARN MORE ][51]

### Earn CME on Your Schedule

Stay current with high-quality emergency medicine education whenever and wherever it works for you.
AAEM CME Online gives members complimentary access to a growing library of on-demand courses
developed by emergency physicians for emergency physicians. Whether you’re looking to sharpen your
clinical skills or fulfill CME requirements, learning is always just a click away.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]


[Patient pictured kneeling next to her Golden Retriever]
[Patient Story][53]

### From Pump to Pup: Finding Comfort in 'Baxter'

Izzy, a young cancer fighter and survivor, loves her dog, Baxter, named after the brand she saw on
the infusion pumps that delivered her chemotherapy.

[Read More][54]
[nurse smiling and standing next to a window ]
[Healthcare Insights][55]

### Technology and Service Support Chronic Disease Management at Home

Conditions such as hypertension, respiratory illnesses and cardiac issues can be monitored
effectively with innovative tools and connected devices.

[Read More][56]
[group event at a baseball game]
[People of Baxter][57]

### The Power of Teamwork to Support Patient Care

Teams bridged the pandemic and borders to bring an innovative ICU bed to life.

[Read More][58]
[Collage of images showing innovations in a manufacturing setting]
[Healthcare Insights][59]

### Supply Chain Innovation Delivers More Nimble, Efficient Solutions

Leaders from Baxter speak about our evolutions in manufacturing and supply chain processes as we
emerge from the COVID-19 pandemic

[Read More][60]
[Kim sitting at her desk smiling]
[People of Baxter][61]

### A Teacher at Heart

After losing her parents to heart disease, Kim resolved to share her knowledge about cardiac
monitoring with HCPs to identify potential issues early.

[Read More][62]
[Chabot graphic]
[Healthcare Insights][63]

### Dr. Chatbot Will See You Now

What role will AI play in healthcare in the future? We believe there are realistic opportunities for
AI to make healthcare more efficient and effective

[Read More][64]
[ Press Release ][65]

### to Drive Meaningful Impact

## Our Commitment to Healthcare Professionals and Patients

We are committed to supporting patients and healthcare professionals with innovations that are
driven by compassion for their journeys, a passion to improve care and the ambition to transform the
future of healthcare.

[A doctor in a hospital room looks off to the side]

## Products for Healthcare Professionals

### Primary Care [ Primary Care Go to Primary Care ][71]

Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
vitals monitoring and vision screening

[ Go to Primary Care ][72]

### Hospital Care [ Hospital Care Go to Hospital Care ][73]

Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
workflows

[ Go to Hospital Care ][74]

### Surgical Care [ Surgical Care Go to Surgical Care ][75]

Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
outcomes

[ Go to Surgical Care ][76]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][77]

Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and at
home

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][78]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][79]

Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve mobility

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][80]

### Our Products [ Our Products Go to Our Products ][81]

Enabling clinicians to treat patients more efficiently and effectively across care settings,
including in the office-based practice, inpatient care, outpatient care and at home

[ Go to Our Products ][82]
[Two ladies have a discussion in a coffee shop]

## For Patients

You are our passion. Your stories inspire us to work harder at bringing innovations that can make
your experience easier, speed recovery and enable the best possible quality of life.

[Discover Patient Stories][83]

### More For Patients

### General Healthcare [ General Healthcare Go to General Healthcare ][84]

Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
support every step of your journey.

[ Go to General Healthcare ][85]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][86]

When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide clinical nutrition
options to help you regain your nutritional status.

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][87]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][88]

We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven respiratory
therapy in the hospital and at home.

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][89]

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

### Our Leadership

Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet our commitments – every
day and everywhere.

[Learn More About Our Leadership][90]

### Our Corporate Responsibility

For nearly a century, we have made a meaningful difference in global healthcare while creating
lasting value for the communities we serve.

[Learn More About Our Corporate Responsibility][91]

### Careers

This is where an inclusive community of diverse individuals is driven to go beyond what is, to what
is possible in healthcare.

[Learn More About Careers at Baxter][92]

### Our History

For more than 90 years, we’ve been focused on our commitment to save and sustain lives with
innovations that elevate patient care, improve outcomes and drive healthcare transformation.

[Learn More About Our History][93]

## The future of healthcare is connected

expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and

connectivity.

## MODULAR DEVICES AND SOFTWARE

### Start with one application, expand in all directions

#### Neurofeedback

Neurofeedback is a non-invasive therapeutic approach that involves measuring brainwave activity for
real-time feedback to the patient. Neurofeedback is indicated for self-regulation of brain function
and endogenous symptom management. With over 35 years of research and experience, BEE Medic
equipment, software, modern animations, and VR games are entertaining, practical, and easy to use.

[ Learn More ][49]

#### Biofeedback

Biofeedback solutions from BEE Medic integrate into your neurofeedback sessions, optimizing your
treatment and enhancing the mind-body connection. Much like neurofeedback, biofeedback devices
measure physiological responses. The body's responses are then displayed to the client within an
engaging animation. BEE Medic offers two biofeedback recording devices as well as software, all of
which integrate seamlessly with your existing neurofeedback equipment.

[ Learn More ][50]

#### Diagnostics & Research

BEE Medic develops high-precision systems for neurodiagnostics, EEG/ERP research and EEG biomarker
development. We work closely together with our partner company HBImed AG and are active in the
research of EEG biomarkers. HBImed AG has a comprehensive reference database and sophisticated ERP
analysis software that is approved as a medical device in Europe and the USA. These systems include
a flexible implementation of any paradigm, high precision timing of audiovisual stimuli for EKPs,
and cognitive evoked potentials. We offer a complete toolchain from recording to database and
biomarker-based reporting.

[ Learn More ][51]

Our newest amplifier supports up to 39 channels or EEG recording suitable for qEEG, ERP and

parameters, tactile feedback, ERP protocols, and research modules.

The ERP Synchronization Device is a stimulus-response synchronization device providing split-second

The Combination Sensor is a biofeedback device equipped with three sensors for accurate, low-noise
measurement of physiological stress indicators. It measures skin conductance, temperature, and heart
rate from the finger and is intended for biofeedback applications.

## WHAT DOES BEE MEDIC DO?

We are your reliable partner in neurofeedback.

BEE Medic is a global supplier of medical equipment and accessories for all mental health
specialists. We provide cutting-edge EEG equipment for therapy, diagnostics & research to licensed
mental health care providers.

Our team of engineers, clinicians, and researchers work hand-in-hand to develop these neurofeedback
solutions for day-to-day patient treatment. The modular design of our equipment and software helps
you acquire only what you need and allows you to expand at any time.

software in your practice.

and enjoyment. By taking these courses, you will benefit from practical training, workshops in small
groups, and case discussions with accredited training providers. These classes are offered both

## MODULAR DEVICES AND SOFTWARE

### Start with one application, expand in all directions

#### Neurofeedback

Neurofeedback is a non-invasive therapeutic approach that involves measuring brainwave activity for
real-time feedback to the patient. Neurofeedback is indicated for self-regulation of brain function
and endogenous symptom management. With over 35 years of research and experience, BEE Medic
equipment, software, modern animations, and VR games are entertaining, practical, and easy to use.

[ Learn More ][49]

#### Biofeedback

Biofeedback solutions from BEE Medic integrate into your neurofeedback sessions, optimizing your
treatment and enhancing the mind-body connection. Much like neurofeedback, biofeedback devices
measure physiological responses. The body's responses are then displayed to the client within an
engaging animation. BEE Medic offers two biofeedback recording devices as well as software, all of
which integrate seamlessly with your existing neurofeedback equipment.

[ Learn More ][50]

#### Diagnostics & Research

BEE Medic develops high-precision systems for neurodiagnostics, EEG/ERP research and EEG biomarker
development. We work closely together with our partner company HBImed AG and are active in the
research of EEG biomarkers. HBImed AG has a comprehensive reference database and sophisticated ERP
analysis software that is approved as a medical device in Europe and the USA. These systems include
a flexible implementation of any paradigm, high precision timing of audiovisual stimuli for EKPs,
and cognitive evoked potentials. We offer a complete toolchain from recording to database and
biomarker-based reporting.

[ Learn More ][51]

## NeuroAmp II

Our ultra-low-noise amplifier allows up to two channel EEG recording for neurofeedback. Compatible
with the combination sensor for biofeedback and tactile feedback device. Allows for infra-low and
frequency-band protocols.

[ Learn More ][52]
[NeuroAmp II]

## NeuroAmp II.5s

Our newest amplifier supports up to 39 channels or EEG recording suitable for qEEG, ERP and
neurofeedback. It allows customizations for 1, 2, 19, or 39-channel EEG recordings, four biofeedback
parameters, tactile feedback, ERP protocols, and research modules.

[ Learn More ][53]
[NeuroAmp II5S]

## Sync Box

The ERP Synchronization Device is a stimulus-response synchronization device providing split-second
accuracy in synchronizing EEG readings to stimulus presentation, intended for ERP measurements.

[ Learn More ][54]
[Sync Box]

## Combi Sensor

The Combination Sensor is a biofeedback device equipped with three sensors for accurate, low-noise
measurement of physiological stress indicators. It measures skin conductance, temperature, and heart
rate from the finger and is intended for biofeedback applications.

[ Learn More ][55]
[Combi Sensor]

## Why BEE Medic?

At BEE Medic, we offer you the right solution from entry into neurofeedback in your own medical
practice, to high-end systems for clinical research. We take special care to ensure that you can
count on quality, innovative, and reliable systems for all your neurofeedback needs.

Our primary goal is to provide our customers with optimal support for their work in order to achieve
the best possible treatment results. We offer expert technical support and connect you with a
network of neurofeedback educators who offer clinically supervised provider training.

# Welcome to The Princess Alexandra Hospital NHS Trust

[ Visiting one of our locations? ][22]
Pause Play

## Our hospitals

We provide a full range of general acute, outpatient and diagnostic services at The Princess
Alexandra Hospital in Harlow, the Herts and Essex Hospital in Bishop’s Stortford, and St Margaret’s
Hospital in Epping.
* [ The Princess Alexandra Hospital ][23]
* [ Herts and Essex Hospital ][24]
* [ St Margaret’s Hospital ][25]

[Locations map]
Infographic content

We employ around 4,000 staff and serve a local population of about 350,000 people living in West
Essex and East Hertfordshire, centred on the M11 corridor and the towns of Harlow, Bishop’s
Stortford and Epping. Our extended catchment area incorporates a population of up to 500,000 and
includes the areas of Hoddesdon, Cheshunt and Broxbourne in Hertfordshire.

We are currently working with system partners to transform how care is delivered for our patients to
offer the highest quality, seamless care possible. Aligned with the three ambitious shifts set out
in the NHS 10 Year plan: analogue to digital; treatment to prevention; and acute to community; we
will take a central role in integrating services with other Trusts and our system partners, primary
care, community services and mental health.

## Building a hospital for the future. Together.

We have a once in a lifetime opportunity to build a new hospital that will transform healthcare for
the people of Harlow and beyond.

[ The New Princess Alexandra Hospital ][26]

## Join us at PAHT

We are proud of our amazing PAHT people and the fantastic care and services they provide – why not
join the team?

[ View career opportunities ][27]

## The Princess Alexandra Hospital Charity

Our charity is dedicated to enhancing patient care, purchasing special equipment, improving
facilities and investing in vital research which is beyond the scope or limits of the NHS.

[ Charity ][28]

## InTouch magazine for our community

Our InTouch magazine is a space for us to celebrate the incredible work happening every day across
The Princess Alexandra Hospital NHS Trust.

[ Read the magazine and find out more here ][29]

consulting services, and analytical information on markets and companies across the world. Data

publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the

  [Inhalational versus total intravenous anesthesia in noncardiac surgery: a comparative review of
  clinical outcomes][90]
  Ah Ran Oh, Jungchan Park
  *Korean J Anesthesiol.* 2026;79(3):264-270.   Published online December 2, 2025
  DOI: [https://doi.org/10.4097/kja.25634][91]

  * [[Pubreader]PubReader][94]

  Inhalational anesthetics have long been the cornerstone of general anesthesia in noncardiac
  surgery owing to their reliable pharmacokinetics, ease of administration, and cardiopulmonary
  benefits such as bronchodilation and myocardial preconditioning. Total intravenous anesthesia
  (TIVA), achieved using short-acting agents such as propofol and remifentanil, and supported by
  target-controlled infusion systems and depth-of-anesthesia monitors, has emerged as a widely
  adopted alternative. TIVA is associated with improved recovery profiles, reduced incidence of
  postoperative nausea and vomiting, and potential neuroprotective and immunomodulatory effects. In
  this review, we compared the pharmacological mechanisms and clinical implications of inhalational
  anesthesia and TIVA, focusing on myocardial injury after noncardiac surgery and other
  perioperative outcomes. We summarized evidence from randomized controlled trials, large-scale
  observational studies, and health system-level analyses across multiple outcome domains: all-cause
  mortality, cardiovascular complications, pulmonary and renal outcomes, oncological prognosis, and
  system-level factors, such as cost-effectiveness and environmental impact. While inhalational
  agents demonstrated advantages in terms of cardioprotection and airway management, TIVA was found
  to offer potential benefits in select populations, particularly in cancer surgery and
  neuroanesthesia. No single technique demonstrated consistent superiority across all clinical
  contexts. Therefore, the selection of anesthetic technique should be personalized based on
  surgical risk, patient comorbidities, institutional infrastructure, and clinician expertise.
  Emerging trends in sustainability and precision medicine further underscore the need for
  individualized evidence-based strategies. By combining mechanistic insights with evidence from
  clinical practice, this review aimed to provide a balanced framework to guide optimal anesthetic
  decision-making in noncardiac surgery.

  agents demonstrated advantages in terms of cardioprotection and airway management, TIVA was found
  to offer potential benefits in select populations, particularly in cancer surgery and
  neuroanesthesia. No single technique demonstrated consistent superiority across all clinical
  contexts. Therefore, the selection of anesthetic technique should be personalized based on
  surgical risk, patient comorbidities, institutional infrastructure, and clinician expertise.
  Emerging trends in sustainability and precision medicine further underscore the need for
  individualized evidence-based strategies. By combining mechanistic insights with evidence from
  clinical practice, this review aimed to provide a balanced framework to guide optimal anesthetic
  decision-making in noncardiac surgery.

# Imparables para que la leucemia sea 100% curable

1 de cada 5 niños y niñas diagnosticadas y el 50% de las personas adultas continúan sin poder
superar la enfermedad.

Gracias a la investigación, la supervivencia en pacientes con leucemia y enfermedades hematológicas
malignas ha aumentado mucho en los últimos 35 años.
En la Fundación, trabajamos con la sociedad para vencer a esta enfermedad y poder gritar algún día:
¡leucemia, hemos acabado contigo!

## Nuestro impacto

Así es como, gracias a personas como tú, hemos luchado contra la leucemia durante los últimos 35
años
y seguimos haciéndolo:

Instituto de Investigación contra la Leucemia Josep Carreras

Más de 600.000 horas anuales de investigación en leucemia y otras enfermedades hematológicas
malignas.

Registro de Donantes de Médula Ósea (REDMO)

Desde 1992, hemos coordinado más de 16.000 trasplantes de médula ósea no emparentados para pacientes
de todo el mundo.

Programa de Experiencia del Paciente y Pisos de Acogida

Hemos atendido más de 20.000 consultas de pacientes y acogido a más de 500 familias en nuestros
pisos de acogida.

# Imparables para que la leucemia sea 100% curable

1 de cada 5 niños y niñas diagnosticadas y el 50% de las personas adultas continúan sin poder
superar la enfermedad.

Gracias a la investigación, la supervivencia en pacientes con leucemia y enfermedades hematológicas
malignas ha aumentado mucho en los últimos 35 años.
En la Fundación, trabajamos con la sociedad para vencer a esta enfermedad y poder gritar algún día:
¡leucemia, hemos acabado contigo!

¿Qué es un catéter endovenoso periférico?

Un **catéter venoso periférico** es un tubo delgado y flexible que se inserta en una vena.
Normalmente, se inserta en la parte inferior del brazo o la parte posterior de la mano. Se usa para
administrar líquidos, transfusiones de sangre, quimioterapia y otros medicamentos por vía
intravenosa.

¿Qué catéter es más grande 14 o 16?

Así tendremos que los más grandes (mayor calibre) serán los 14 G, llegando a los pequeños
(pediátricos) del 20 / 22 G. 14 G 16G 18G 20 G.

¿Qué es un catéter número 16?

Catéter intravenoso de poliuretano termosensible, simple via, para introducción en vena de gran
calibre (yugular o subclavia). Permite realizar reiteradas tomas de sangre, administración continua
de medicamentos para evitar los efectos indeseables de una inyección de bolo.

¿Cuáles son los tipos de catéter?

Pueden ser de longitud corta, media o larga, y de calibre variable. En general, el calibre de los
**catéteres periféricos** se mide en Gauges o “calibre”; su valor es inversamente proporcional al
grosor de la aguja.

[Geomedic proteccion medica a tu alcance][70]

¿Cuánto dura un catéter venoso periférico?

Por lo que se establecen tres días como duración máxima de tiempo para usar las líneas
intravasculares periféricas. Se deben cambiar los lugares cada 72-96 horas para reducir el riesgo de
infección y flebitis. Si las cánulas son de acero o plástico se pueden dejar en su lugar durante un
máximo de 72 horas.

¿Qué es la aguja espinal?

Las **agujas espinales** son un producto exclusivo para la práctica de procedimientos llamados
«punciones lumbares» en las que se coloca una aguja en la parte posterior de la espalda del paciente
para extraer líquido o colocar una medicación determinada.

¿Qué aguja se usa para epidural?

Una **aguja Whitacre** con calibre 25 o 27 para minimizar la pérdida de LCR.

¿Qué son los guantes quirúrgicos y para qué sirven?

Los **guantes** son un tipo de equipo de protección personal (EPP). Otros tipos de EPP son las
batas, mascarillas, y cubiertas para los zapatos y la cabeza. Los guantes crean una barrera entre
los microbios y las manos. Usarlos en el hospital evita que los microbios se diseminen.

¿Cómo se clasifican los guantes quirúrgicos?

Según su esterilidad: **Guantes de cirugía (estériles)**. *Guantes de examen (estériles y no
estériles)*.

[Geomedic proteccion medica a tu alcance][71]

¿Cuáles son los tipos de guantes en salud?

Se distinguen entre **guantes de examen**, que pueden ser estériles o no, y quirúrgicos, que son
estériles.

¿Qué son los guantes de examen?

Los **guantes de examen** se encuentran entre los consumibles médicos más importantes y de mayor
uso. Garantizan un alto nivel de seguridad e higiene durante el tratamiento, examen o limpieza del
paciente, pues evitan el contacto directo entre la piel del médico y la del paciente.

¿Qué tipo de guantes se usan en el laboratorio?

Los **guantes de nitrilo** ofrecen una excelente protección contra una amplia gama de peligros
comunes en los laboratorios químicos y es sumamente recomendable ya que no desencadenan alergias al
látex, y son resistentes a los pinchazos.

¿Qué es un catéter endovenoso periférico?

Un **catéter venoso periférico** es un tubo delgado y flexible que se inserta en una vena.
Normalmente, se inserta en la parte inferior del brazo o la parte posterior de la mano. Se usa para
administrar líquidos, transfusiones de sangre, quimioterapia y otros medicamentos por vía
intravenosa.

¿Qué catéter es más grande 14 o 16?

Así tendremos que los más grandes (mayor calibre) serán los 14 G, llegando a los pequeños
(pediátricos) del 20 / 22 G. 14 G 16G 18G 20 G.

¿Qué es un catéter número 16?

Catéter intravenoso de poliuretano termosensible, simple via, para introducción en vena de gran
calibre (yugular o subclavia). Permite realizar reiteradas tomas de sangre, administración continua
de medicamentos para evitar los efectos indeseables de una inyección de bolo.

¿Cuáles son los tipos de catéter?

Pueden ser de longitud corta, media o larga, y de calibre variable. En general, el calibre de los
**catéteres periféricos** se mide en Gauges o “calibre”; su valor es inversamente proporcional al
grosor de la aguja.

[Geomedic proteccion medica a tu alcance][70]

¿Cuánto dura un catéter venoso periférico?

Por lo que se establecen tres días como duración máxima de tiempo para usar las líneas
intravasculares periféricas. Se deben cambiar los lugares cada 72-96 horas para reducir el riesgo de
infección y flebitis. Si las cánulas son de acero o plástico se pueden dejar en su lugar durante un
máximo de 72 horas.

¿Qué es la aguja espinal?

Las **agujas espinales** son un producto exclusivo para la práctica de procedimientos llamados
«punciones lumbares» en las que se coloca una aguja en la parte posterior de la espalda del paciente
para extraer líquido o colocar una medicación determinada.

¿Qué aguja se usa para epidural?

Una **aguja Whitacre** con calibre 25 o 27 para minimizar la pérdida de LCR.

¿Qué son los guantes quirúrgicos y para qué sirven?

Los **guantes** son un tipo de equipo de protección personal (EPP). Otros tipos de EPP son las
batas, mascarillas, y cubiertas para los zapatos y la cabeza. Los guantes crean una barrera entre
los microbios y las manos. Usarlos en el hospital evita que los microbios se diseminen.

¿Cómo se clasifican los guantes quirúrgicos?

Según su esterilidad: **Guantes de cirugía (estériles)**. *Guantes de examen (estériles y no
estériles)*.

[Geomedic proteccion medica a tu alcance][71]

¿Cuáles son los tipos de guantes en salud?

Se distinguen entre **guantes de examen**, que pueden ser estériles o no, y quirúrgicos, que son
estériles.

¿Qué son los guantes de examen?

Los **guantes de examen** se encuentran entre los consumibles médicos más importantes y de mayor
uso. Garantizan un alto nivel de seguridad e higiene durante el tratamiento, examen o limpieza del
paciente, pues evitan el contacto directo entre la piel del médico y la del paciente.

¿Qué tipo de guantes se usan en el laboratorio?

Los **guantes de nitrilo** ofrecen una excelente protección contra una amplia gama de peligros
comunes en los laboratorios químicos y es sumamente recomendable ya que no desencadenan alergias al
látex, y son resistentes a los pinchazos.

[Geomedic proteccion medica a tu alcance][72]

## Customer Testimonial

Thank you, GRP team, for registering our DMF in china. Your helped us achieve a big milestone for
our company. The support and the commitment of your regulatory team have exceeded our expectations
and made it easier for us to communicate with NMPA the Chinese authority. All the best !
Director of Regulatory Affairs Officer- CMC- A Large European Pharmaceutical Company based in
Switzerland
We have been working with Global Regulatory Partners for 5 years and we consider them as our real
partner and not as a consulting company, they had submitted 3 INDs for us with FDA successfully .
The GRP team performs all IND amendments and annual reporting to FDA, we don’t have to worry about
not being in compliance with FDA requirements at all.
CEO of Medium Size American Pharmaceutical Company operating in Nanotechnology based in USA

clinical study. Finding the qualified CRO for the study management in China was very challenging
process because of the language barrier and the lack of understanding of GCP and ICH requirements.
We finally found Global Regulatory Partners, that has a local team of professionals in regulatory
and clinical affairs in china who supported our clinical study in China, but also helped us to
understand the Chinese regulations related to our product.
CMO of Large European Pharmaceutical Company based in France and Operating in Radiopharmaceuticals
I am very impressed on how quickly Global Regulatory Affairs team was able to prepare and organize a
face to face consultation meeting for our company with Anvisa in Brazil, The meeting was successful
and helped us to validate and conform the regulatory strategy of our device registration in Brazil.

Thank you, GRP team, for registering our DMF in china. Your helped us achieve a big milestone for
our company. The support and the commitment of your regulatory team have exceeded our expectations
and made it easier for us to communicate with NMPA the Chinese authority. All the best !
Director of Regulatory Affairs Officer- CMC- A Large European Pharmaceutical Company based in
Switzerland
We have been working with Global Regulatory Partners for 5 years and we consider them as our real
partner and not as a consulting company, they had submitted 3 INDs for us with FDA successfully .
The GRP team performs all IND amendments and annual reporting to FDA, we don’t have to worry about
not being in compliance with FDA requirements at all.
CEO of Medium Size American Pharmaceutical Company operating in Nanotechnology based in USA

clinical study. Finding the qualified CRO for the study management in China was very challenging
process because of the language barrier and the lack of understanding of GCP and ICH requirements.
We finally found Global Regulatory Partners, that has a local team of professionals in regulatory
and clinical affairs in china who supported our clinical study in China, but also helped us to
understand the Chinese regulations related to our product.
CMO of Large European Pharmaceutical Company based in France and Operating in Radiopharmaceuticals
I am very impressed on how quickly Global Regulatory Affairs team was able to prepare and organize a
face to face consultation meeting for our company with Anvisa in Brazil, The meeting was successful
and helped us to validate and conform the regulatory strategy of our device registration in Brazil.

#### COMPANY PROFILE

Haolang Medical is an expert in creating, producing, and marketing a range of vascular access,
infusion therapy, and infection control products. The business was founded in 2006. With an M.D.
leading our R&D team and over 300 people, our company has achieved several international patents,
some of which are the first in the world.

Our products fall into four main categories: catheters for central veins (CVC, PICC, hemodialysis
catheters), peripheral vein devices (Midline and Mini Midline), and catheters for needle-less valves
and infection caps. Our product line also includes arterial, peritoneal, and umbilical catheters,
among other medical equipment.

## Health Line produces power-injectable, multi-lumen intravenous catheter kits healthcare

### [ PICC Line Kits ][19]

Offered in single, double, and triple lumen configurations and indicated for adult, pediatric, and
neonatal patients, our selection of kit options makes Health Line one of the leading PICC line
catheter manufacturers in the U.S.

[Learn More ›][20]

### [ Midline Catheter Kits ][21]

Health Line's midline catheter kits include everything clinicians need for standard, safe and easy
insertions, and our midline catheters negate the need for multiple needle sticks and don’t require
an X-ray post-insertion.

[Learn More ›][22]

### [ Central Venous Catheter Kits ][23]

As a OEM central venous catheter manufacturer and distributor, we supply our global partners with
non-tunneled CVC kits in a variety of sizes and lengths intended for short-term intravenous
therapies.

[Learn More ›][24]

### [ Hemodialysis Catheter Kits ][25]

Available in single, dual, and triple lumen configurations, our tunneled and non-tunneled
hemodialysis catheter kits are indicated for temporary, chronic, and permanent dialysis and
apheresis treatments.

[Learn More ›][26]

### [ IV Administration Sets ][27]

We manufacture DEHP-free IV administration primary sets with multiple Y-site connection options that
are gravity and pump compatible, as well as complimentary secondary and extension IV sets in a
variety of configurations.

[Learn More ›][28]

### [ All Vascular Access Products ][29]

Our vascular access products enable clinicians to safely and easily administer infusion therapies.
View Health Line’s entire line of PICC line kits, midline catheters, central line kits, hemodialysis
catheters, and IV administration sets.

### Frequently Asked Questions

Can I access Ninja Nerd for free?

Absolutely. All core video lectures remain free on YouTube and ninjanerd.org. A paid membership is
only required if you want downloadable notes, high-resolution illustrations, quizzes, flashcards,
and slide decks!

What topics does Ninja Nerd cover?

Explore our extensive library [here][12]! We provide a wide range of content, from foundational
sciences to clinical medicine, designed to support you throughout your entire learning journey.

When I sign up, will I be able to download notes & illustrations?

Yes. Members can print or download every PDF note and both the “Template” (blank) and “Key”
(completed) illustration for every lecture.

Can I use my subscription from multiple devices and locations?

Yes—log in from any phone, tablet, or computer. Simultaneous log-ins on different devices aren't
allowed under the Terms & Conditions.

Do you offer a free trial?

Not at this time. However, we update our YouTube channel weekly, so you can sample our teaching
style before subscribing.

Do you offer CME/CE credits?

CME is not yet available, but it is on our future-feature road-map.

**Revista Electrónica de PortalesMedicos.com – ISSN 1886-8924 **

Revista de **acceso abierto** y de **edición quincenal** de publicaciones de **Medicina, Enfermería
y Ciencias de la Salud**, dirigida a **profesionales de la salud** de habla hispana, con el objetivo
de mantenerlos actualizados en los avances científicos, difundir nuevos conocimientos y promover la
formación continua en las diversas especialidades del conocimiento médico actual.

[Leer el último número publicado][99]


 

 

**Nuevos artículos con DOI (Digital Object Identifier)**

La revista incorpora ahora el identificador digital DOI en todos los artículos nuevos.
Este avance mejora la trazabilidad, la citación y la visibilidad internacional de los trabajos
publicados.

[[Nefrología (English Edition)]][41]
ISSN: 2013-2514

Nefrología is the official publication of the Spanish Society of Nephrology. The Journal publishes
articles on basic or clinical research relating to nephrology, arterial hypertension, dialysis and
kidney transplants. It is governed by the peer review system and all original papers are subject to
internal assessment and external reviews. The journal accepts submissions of articles in English and
in Spanish languages. Nefrología follows the publication requirements of the International Committee
of Medical Journal Editors (ICMJE) and the Committee on Publication Ethics (COPE).

Nefrología is a Diamond Open Access journal: it charges no article processing charges (APCs) to
authors and no access fees to readers. It is open to authors of any affiliation, country or status.
Publishing costs are fully covered by the Spanish Society of Nephrology (SEN).

Nefrología is owned by the Spanish Society of Nephrology (SEN), a not-for-profit scientific society.
Elsevier provides editorial and production services only; content and editorial decisions rest with
the SEN and the journal's Editorial Board.

## ABOUT US

# THE BEST TELEHEALTH SOLUTIONS PROVIDER

**SK-Telemed GmbH **is a complete system integrator for IT solutions in healthcare business
processes. Collaboration with industry leaders in software and hardware, high competence of our
team, successful experience of implemented projects and stable growth of demand for our services
open another level of workflow for our clients. We deliver healthcare software development services
for hospitals, doctors, patients ensuring high level of digital healthcare service and health
management. Healthcare providers with our software solutions improve medical workflows, enhance
treatment, diagnostics and organize secure data transfer between healthcare departments.

SK-Telemed GmbH has passed the audits and is now certified according to ISO 9001:2015 and
13485:2016. [Read more about SK-Telemed GmbH][15].

**SK-Telemed GmbH is a member of **
**AAL Austria, Telemed Austria**

#### Mission

We increase a level of healthcare services with help of cutting-edge IT solutions.
With our solutions, healthcare providers improve medical workflow, enhance treatment, diagnostic and
continuous monitoring, organize secure data transfer.

#### Position

Our digital solutions connect doctors, patients, and partners. We develop precise digital tools for
remote monitoring, treatment, communication and care that really elevate the quality of medical
services especially in the COVID-19 era.

#### Strategy

We use mHealth, telehealth, IoMT, AI algorithms and other technologies to facilitate a diagnostic
process, to enhance a monitoring of the patients health status, to provide a continuous care, and to
give proper treatment solutions.

## PRODUCTS

[IDIS2GO]

**Telehealth medical diagnostic system IDIS2GO is a telemetry solution for remote diagnostic. The
diagnostic clinic just in one bag!**
* Open platform with number of portable connected devices (12-channel ECG, urine analizer,
  spirometer, blood pressure, glucometer, SpO2, dermatoscope, digital stethoscope, wireless doppler,
  fetal doppler, etc).
* Diagnostic in remote locations: rural areas, transport, production and military units.
* Remote access for medical specialists to diagnostic results.
* AI for doctor decision support.

[More information][16]

**Worldwide Doctor-to-Patient communication and monitoring platform. Show2Doc connects with the
portable medical devices. The complete health monitoring for home use!**

It allows virtual care with possibility of complete outpatient treatment without physical visits to
clinic: 
* convenient task manager
* chat for instant feedback
* doctor prescription fulfillment control
* user-friendly intuitive interface
* patient diary
* videocalls in necessary cases

[More information][17]
[Patient portal with the web and mobile app Medcard24]
[Medcard24]

**Patient portal with the web and mobile app. Medcard24 allows you to:**
* find doctors or clinics
* schedule the appointments
* check the personal medical data in EHRs/EMRs
* book the online-consultations
* recieve the electronic prescriptions
* find medicine in the nearest pharmacy and purchase it online

[More information][18]
[ePrescription]

**Unified system for prescription registration, accounting and monitoring**.

Single e-prescriptions database.
Identification doctor, pharmacist and medical prescription. Online reporting.

**This program was created to:**
* medical prescription process automation
* control of distribution of medicines to pharmacies
* creation of reimbursement register of drug costs
* analytical reports generating

[More information][19]
[e-prescriptions database]
[Telemedicine portal]
[Telemed24]

**Telemedicine platform**

Complete telemedicine module, with doctor’s time management, Doctor-to-Doctor and Patient-to-Doctor
remote consultation workflows, electronic health record (EHR), diagnostic results and video calling.

**Telemedicine portal includes:**
* Telemedicine consultation
* Video calling
* Home telemedicine
* Search of consultants

[More information][20]

## ABOUT US

# THE BEST TELEHEALTH SOLUTIONS PROVIDER

**SK-Telemed GmbH **is a complete system integrator for IT solutions in healthcare business
processes. Collaboration with industry leaders in software and hardware, high competence of our
team, successful experience of implemented projects and stable growth of demand for our services
open another level of workflow for our clients. We deliver healthcare software development services
for hospitals, doctors, patients ensuring high level of digital healthcare service and health
management. Healthcare providers with our software solutions improve medical workflows, enhance
treatment, diagnostics and organize secure data transfer between healthcare departments.

SK-Telemed GmbH has passed the audits and is now certified according to ISO 9001:2015 and
13485:2016. [Read more about SK-Telemed GmbH][15].

**SK-Telemed GmbH is a member of **
**AAL Austria, Telemed Austria**

#### Mission

We increase a level of healthcare services with help of cutting-edge IT solutions.
With our solutions, healthcare providers improve medical workflow, enhance treatment, diagnostic and
continuous monitoring, organize secure data transfer.

#### Position

Our digital solutions connect doctors, patients, and partners. We develop precise digital tools for
remote monitoring, treatment, communication and care that really elevate the quality of medical
services especially in the COVID-19 era.

#### Strategy

We use mHealth, telehealth, IoMT, AI algorithms and other technologies to facilitate a diagnostic
process, to enhance a monitoring of the patients health status, to provide a continuous care, and to
give proper treatment solutions.

## PRODUCTS

[IDIS2GO]

**Telehealth medical diagnostic system IDIS2GO is a telemetry solution for remote diagnostic. The
diagnostic clinic just in one bag!**
* Open platform with number of portable connected devices (12-channel ECG, urine analizer,
  spirometer, blood pressure, glucometer, SpO2, dermatoscope, digital stethoscope, wireless doppler,
  fetal doppler, etc).
* Diagnostic in remote locations: rural areas, transport, production and military units.
* Remote access for medical specialists to diagnostic results.
* AI for doctor decision support.

[More information][16]

**Worldwide Doctor-to-Patient communication and monitoring platform. Show2Doc connects with the
portable medical devices. The complete health monitoring for home use!**

It allows virtual care with possibility of complete outpatient treatment without physical visits to
clinic: 
* convenient task manager
* chat for instant feedback
* doctor prescription fulfillment control
* user-friendly intuitive interface
* patient diary
* videocalls in necessary cases

[More information][17]
[Patient portal with the web and mobile app Medcard24]
[Medcard24]

**Patient portal with the web and mobile app. Medcard24 allows you to:**
* find doctors or clinics
* schedule the appointments
* check the personal medical data in EHRs/EMRs
* book the online-consultations
* recieve the electronic prescriptions
* find medicine in the nearest pharmacy and purchase it online

[More information][18]
[ePrescription]

**Unified system for prescription registration, accounting and monitoring**.

Single e-prescriptions database.
Identification doctor, pharmacist and medical prescription. Online reporting.

**This program was created to:**
* medical prescription process automation
* control of distribution of medicines to pharmacies
* creation of reimbursement register of drug costs
* analytical reports generating

[More information][19]
[e-prescriptions database]
[Telemedicine portal]
[Telemed24]

**Telemedicine platform**

Complete telemedicine module, with doctor’s time management, Doctor-to-Doctor and Patient-to-Doctor
remote consultation workflows, electronic health record (EHR), diagnostic results and video calling.

**Telemedicine portal includes:**
* Telemedicine consultation
* Video calling
* Home telemedicine
* Search of consultants

guide strategy, investment, innovation, and organizational resilience.

## Strategic Revenue Advisory

Our Strategic Revenue Advisory helps organizations make confident, evidence-driven decisions about
where to focus, how to grow, and which capabilities matter most. We integrate market insight,

resilient, high-impact, and aligned with long-term growth opportunities.

## Deliverables That Drive Revenue Decisions

Research outputs designed to plug directly into planning, investment and board level discussions.

### From Insight to Implementation

#### Data Collection

Structured gathering of market, customer, financial and competitive data from primary and secondary
sources.

#### Analytics and Modelling

Use of quantitative models and AI supported analysis to reveal patterns, stress points and leading
indicators.

#### Insight Development

Senior analysts translate findings into clear storylines and strategic implications.

#### Actionable Deliverables

Concrete recommendations, prioritised actions and quantified impact ranges.

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Support in defining KPIs and tracking how decisions influence revenue, margin and risk over time.

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

### Informed Strategic Planning

We give strategy, finance and business leaders a common, fact-based view of the markets they operate
in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do
next”.

### Stronger Investment and Portfolio Choices

By linking market outlooks to product, geography and customer portfolios, we help you decide where
to expand, where to hold and where to exit. The result is sharper focus and better use of capital.

### Faster, More Confident Execution

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

## Ready to turn market uncertainty into revenue clarity

Our consultants are ready to support your next strategy cycle, investment decision or market entry
initiative with clear, evidence based insight.

[Connect with Our Experts][53]

Our consultants are ready to help craft a future-focused, resilient, and innovative packaging
strategy tailored to your needs.

Connect with us through [www.strategicrevenueinsights.com][54] to discover how we can support your
packaging vision and operationalize your ambitions into tangible market impact.

**KoreaMed Synapse** is a digital archive and the reference-linking platform of Korean medical
joujrnals. First, it shall make landing pages of journals easily accessible from other journals via
the DOI system. Second, it shall pave the way for access to full text of referenced articles from
landing pages. Third, it shall install the full text of papers and hyperlink the full text of
participating journals. Fourth, it shall provide tables and figures in English, even if the full
text is written in Korean.

joujrnals. First, it shall make landing pages of journals easily accessible from other journals via
the DOI system. Second, it shall pave the way for access to full text of referenced articles from
landing pages. Third, it shall install the full text of papers and hyperlink the full text of
participating journals. Fourth, it shall provide tables and figures in English, even if the full
text is written in Korean.

Tianck Medical CO.LTD

Tianck Medical CO.LTD is a professional medical devices manufacturer dedicates to R&D, production
and sales. We keep the sustained research & develop strategy and made an excellent achievement in

price.

guidewires, introducer sheaths, balloon inflation devices, drainage catheters, dialysis catheters,
ureteral stents, pressure transducers and so on. Our products have been exported to many countries
in Europe, Asia, South America, Oceania and Africa.

### Peripherally Inserted Central Catheter (PICC): Building a Safe, Precise, and Efficient
### "Lifeline" — 2026 Global PICC Product and Technology Frontiers

In clinical settings such as oncology chemotherapy, long-term parenteral nutrition, intensive care,
and prolonged antibiotic therapy, establishing a safe and reliable central venous access is often
directly linked to patient outcomes and quality of life. The Peripherally Inserted Central Catheter
(PICC), owing to its minimally invasive nature, safety profile, and bedside operability, is
increasingly becoming the first-line choice for intravenous therapy.

][208]
[
June 30 2026

### Cardiovascular Interventional Products: Innovation and Breakthroughs Reshaping the Industry

Cardiovascular disease remains one of the most significant global health threats. In China,
approximately 330 million people suffer from cardiovascular diseases, including about 11.39 million
with coronary artery disease (CAD). Amid accelerating population aging and the widespread adoption
of minimally invasive therapeutic concepts, cardiovascular interventional products are evolving at
an unprecedented pace. From the “leave nothing behind” strategy of drug-coated balloons to
breakthroughs in intravascular lithotripsy (IVL), from the approval of the first domestically
developed interventional artificial heart to the clinical deployment of vascular interventional
surgical robots, a series of milestones indicate that cardiovascular interventional therapy has
entered a brand-new phase. Simultaneously, volume-based procurement (VBP) policies continue to
reshape the industry landscape, domestic substitution is accelerating, and the cardiovascular
intervention sector is moving from “data prosperity” towards “value creation”.

### "Lifeline" — 2026 Global PICC Product and Technology Frontiers

In clinical settings such as oncology chemotherapy, long-term parenteral nutrition, intensive care,
and prolonged antibiotic therapy, establishing a safe and reliable central venous access is often
directly linked to patient outcomes and quality of life. The Peripherally Inserted Central Catheter
(PICC), owing to its minimally invasive nature, safety profile, and bedside operability, is
increasingly becoming the first-line choice for intravenous therapy.

### Cardiovascular Interventional Products: Innovation and Breakthroughs Reshaping the Industry

Cardiovascular disease remains one of the most significant global health threats. In China,
approximately 330 million people suffer from cardiovascular diseases, including about 11.39 million
with coronary artery disease (CAD). Amid accelerating population aging and the widespread adoption
of minimally invasive therapeutic concepts, cardiovascular interventional products are evolving at
an unprecedented pace. From the “leave nothing behind” strategy of drug-coated balloons to
breakthroughs in intravascular lithotripsy (IVL), from the approval of the first domestically
developed interventional artificial heart to the clinical deployment of vascular interventional
surgical robots, a series of milestones indicate that cardiovascular interventional therapy has
entered a brand-new phase. Simultaneously, volume-based procurement (VBP) policies continue to
reshape the industry landscape, domestic substitution is accelerating, and the cardiovascular
intervention sector is moving from “data prosperity” towards “value creation”.
